reference_assumption: The SolidWorks mass report's Coordinate System1 origin is assumed to coincide with the exported STEP top-level global origin. The STEP contains an identity top-level placement but does not retain a named Coordinate System1 relationship, so this origin equivalence is high-confidence rather than directly provable from the STEP file alone.

volume_validation.source: Pool measurement: at rho=1000 kg/m^3 the 11.301 kg vehicle has 0.24 kg-equivalent positive buoyancy, so displaced volume is (11.301+0.24)/1000 = 0.011541 m^3. The SolidWorks material volume is not displaced volume.

main_buoyancy_material.hydrodynamic_accounting: included once by geometry union; never add this volume numerically to the 11.541 L displacement target
main_buoyancy_material.double_count_prevention: This preserved solid is already part of the output geometry union; its measured volume is not added numerically to the displacement target.

sealed_pressure_boundary.hydrodynamic_accounting: The disks close the waterproof boundary only; external annular-fitting recesses remain floodable and no cavity volume is numerically added.
